name: Drone Flight Simulator
summary:
Educational software for years 4 to 10 & STEM. Designed for full class rotational use with virtual tutor direct instructions. 

VR Drone Flight Simulator is an immersive educational experience that lets students safely explore the world of drones while building real-world STEM skills. Students can pilot drones in a virtual environment, mastering controls, physics, and experimenting by swapping components or cargo to see how changes affect flight.
